difficulty_reason: The proof reconstructs the full combinatorial symmetry group from intersection counts of complements of Birkhoff facets, then transports commuting regular actions into that group. A Chermak–Delgado measure and normalizer argument constrains the group, while a stabilizer facet, Frobenius reciprocity, and a representation-polytope dimension formula isolate the standard constituent. The explicit C6 case at n=3 handles the low-dimensional exception; combining polytope face combinatorics, finite-group structure, and character theory exceeds routine doctoral qualifying material.
